Jane — perfect, thanks for the clarity and procurement contact. I've attached a short benchmarking workbook that lays out target $/1M tokens across a few scenarios:

- Self-serve hosted (no commit): baseline per-unit with typical batching and KV cache savings (estimates assume similar inference mix to what you described).
- Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit): shows committed discount levels at 3-month / 6-month / 12-month commits.
- Quantization + model variant mix: shows lower unit cost if you adopt int8/4-bit or a smaller open-model for high-volume inference where quality tradeoffs are acceptable.

High-level takeaway from our preliminary numbers (see attached):
- Without commitments, per-unit for your current profile sits around ~$45–$60 / 1M tokens (model + infra + ops).
- With a 12-month reserved capacity and aggressive batching/quantization, we can model down to ~$18–$28 / 1M tokens at 500M tokens/month depending on model mix and KV cache hit rates.
- For comparison, your OpenAI/Anthropic quotes are higher at the same quality tier; hosted open-model options can be cheaper but carry ops overhead and variable reliability.

Attached: redwood_target_price_benchmark_v1.xlsx (tabs: assumptions, raw_unit_costs, 3_commit_scenarios, recommended_pricing) and a one-pager (pricing_notes_acme.pdf).
